name: Takanashi Reiko
source:
She works for the company where the main character used to work. She is an all-around beauty and is well received by her boss, but she is feared by her colleagues because she tends to trample on others behind her back. She is currently the president's secretary, but there are rumors that she used her body to get her current position.

[Edited from [url=https://www.debonosu.jp/euphoria/game/soy_rankaku/character.html]Official site[/url]]
